name: SDIT Al-Uswah Jakarta
address: Jl. Pratama No.21, Srengseng Sawah, Jagakarsa, Jakarta Selatan

notes.id: Uang pangkal = dana pengembangan sarana prasarana. SPP termasuk katering dan ekstrakurikuler. Total masuk Rp18.000.000; potongan Rp500.000 untuk 50 pendaftar pertama. Per November 2026 kuota pendaftaran online dan offline sudah terpenuhi.
notes.en: Entry fee = facilities development fund. Tuition includes catering and extracurriculars. Total on entry Rp18,000,000; Rp500,000 off for the first 50 applicants. As of November 2026 both online and offline quotas are full.

source.title: Info PMB SDIT Al-Uswah TP 2027/2028 (situs resmi)
